standard.summary: 训练时采样的最小时间步（包含）。0=几乎无噪声（最终细节），1000=纯噪声（整体结构）。例如风格 LoRA 可设置 500 只影响早期构图。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The smallest timestep sampled during training (inclusive). 0 = almost no noise (the final details), 1000 = pure noise (the overall structure). A style LoRA could set 500, for example, to affect only the early composition.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced_en.principle: Minimum timestep sampled during training (inclusive). 0 = almost no noise (final details), 1000 = pure noise (overall structure). E.g. a style LoRA can set 500 to affect only early composition.
